settings_checker_desc_advanced: E tlhola thulaganyo ya Linux e e gatetseng pele ya Sediriswa sa SP Flash, phitlhelelo ya USB, ditetlelelo tsa tatelano, le dikarolo tsa tsamaiso.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: E dira gore khomphutha ya gago e siametse go golagana le setshamekisi sa gago le go tsenya dintšhwafatso tsa serweboleta ka tsela e e ikanyegang.

linux_prep_ready: E loketse, Sesebediswa sa Flash sa SP se lokiseditswe.

linux_prep_needs_access: Phitlhelelo e ne e sa newa, go phatsima go a e tlhoka.
linux_prep_fixed: Phitlhelelo e neetswe, Sediriswa sa SP Flash se siame.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Setup e fedile mme akhaonto ya gago e tsentswe mo ditlhopheng tsa badirisi tse di tlhokegang tsa SP Flash Tool. Tsweetswee simolola khomphutha ya gago gape gore ditetlelelo tse disha di simolole go dira, o bo o bula tiriswa gape. Tobetsa letshwao go tswala tiriswa gone jaanong.

settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.

settings_terminal_install: Tsenya go tswa mo fensetereng ya theminale

settings_sp_auth_desc: Ga e patelediwe. Dipheo tse ding tsa MediaTek di hana ho phatsima ho fihlela SP Flash Tool e fuwa faele ya netefatso (.auth); tsenya ya gago fano fa sediriswa se tlhoka.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Ga go na faele ya go gasaganya e e neng ya bonwa mo sephuthelwaneng seno, ka jalo ga go na taelo ya khonsole e e neng ya ka agiwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Ga go na SP Flash Tool e e agilweng kgotsa ntlha ya go tsena ya MTKClient e e leng teng mo mokgweng ono.
terminal_install_failed: Ga e kgone go bula fensetere ya theminale. Taelo ya go tsenya e ne e kwadilwe go {path}.
status_terminal_install: Tsenya taelo e e butsweng mo fensetereng ya theminale ya gago ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} jaanong e tla bula go taboga {method}.

• Fa e sa ntse e sa timilwe, tima {device} ya gago.
• Fa e golagantswe le USB, e kgaole pele.
{hint}
• Golaganya sediriswa sa gago le khomphutara ya gago fa fensetere ya {terminal_name} e butswe.

Tobetsa OK go simolola le go tswa mo Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Tlhabo-botlhale: Fa sediriswa se sa golagane ka go itirisa, tobetsa ka bonolo konopo ya go seta gape mo lesobeng la pin ka setshwareledi sa pampiri fa o ntse o golaganya thapo ya USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Tlhabo-botlhale: Beya sediriswa sa gago mo mokgweng wa go laisolola sediriswa sa sediriswa (se farologana go ya ka sekao: sk. ntsha beteri mme o e boloke e le kwa ntle fa thapo ya USB e golagantswe, kgotsa tima motlakase fa beteri e tsentswe, kgotsa tshwara Volume Down/Up fa o golagantse USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Tsenya ka GUI ya Sediriswa sa Folashe sa SP
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI jaanong e tla bulega ka serweboleta sa gago se laisitswe pele.

• Mo Sedirisweng sa SP Flash, tlhopha "Laisolola" mo lebokosong le le fologang.
• Tobetsa konopo ya "Laisolola".
• Netefatsa gore {device} ya gago e timilwe le go kgaoganngwa.
{hint}
• Golaganya thapo ya USB le khomphutara ya gago morago ga go tobetsa Download.

Tobetsa OK go simolola Sediriswa sa SP Flash mme o tswe mo Setlhabololong sa.

settings_filter_original_pre307: Bontsha ditokololo tsa Serweboleta sa Ntlha sa bogologolo go feta 3.0.7

Ditokololo tsa Serweboleta sa ntlha tsa bogologolo go feta 3.0.7 ga di tsamaisane le diyuniti tsa Y1 tse di rekisiwang le Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Go phatsima kago ya bogologolo mo diyuniting tseno go tla di thibela go simolola go fitlha mofuta o mosha o tsenngwa gape.

settings_filter_nightly: Bontsha Ditokololo tsa Dev tsa Bosigo

Ditokololo tsa Rockbox-Y1 pele ga 0.5 ga di tsamaisane le diyuniti tsa Y1 tse di rekisiwang morago ga Mopitlwe 2026 ka Innioasis OS 3.0.7 e e tsenngwang pele.

GUI ya Sediriswa sa SP Flash jaanong e tla simolola.

• Fa e sa ntse e sa timiwa, tima sediriswa sa gago.
• Fa e golagantswe le USB, e kgaole pele.
• Mo Sedirisweng sa SP Flash, tobetsa Laisolola.

support_story_1_headline: Fa batlhagisi ba tswelela pele, morafe o a tlhatloga.
support_story_1_lead: Go sireletsa sediriswa sa gago mo diraing tsa serweboleta se se didimetseng le dipoeletso tse di robegileng.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis ka metlha e ntsha di-firmware tse disha tsa batshameki ba ba tshwanang le Y1 (e e lebileng diphetolo tsa boto e e fitlhegileng jaaka 6.0, 7.0, le 8.0) tse di thubang didirisiwa tsa bogologolo ka tidimalo. Se se maswe le go feta, webosaete ya bone e naya ditlhagiso tsa lefela le phitlhelelo ya lefela ya di-firmware tse di dirang tse di fetileng go boela mo seemong sa ditena. Updater le porojeke ya Community Firmware di tsaya dikarolo: re boloka ROM nngwe le nngwe ya setoko sa bogologolo, re netefatsa ka go itirisa poeletso ya gago ya serweboleta, mme re boloka sebapadi sa gago se dira sentle.
support_story_1_item_1: Go Namola Batshameki ba ba Thubegileng: Ditlhotlhomiso tsa pabalesego di netefatsa gore dintšhwafatso tse disha ga di ke di kgoreletsa serweboleta sa bogologolo.
support_story_1_item_2: Di-ROM tsa Setoko tse di Bolokilweng: Pokello e e feletseng ya di-firmware tsa ntlha tsa feketori Innioasis e phimotswe.
support_story_1_item_3: Sethala sa Sefapano sa Naga: Didirisiwa tse di phatsimang tse di feletseng tsa macOS, Linux, le Windows ka go tshwana.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Bohlale: Jarolla ka ho iketsa boto lemoha e le hore o dule o fumana sephuthelwana se nepahetseng.
support_story_2_headline: Ga go na Di-Drive tsa Google tse di robegileng. Ga go na tiro ya go fopholetsa. Sediriswa se se dirang fela.
support_story_2_lead: Mafaratlhatlha a baagi a a lebelo, a a netefaditsweng a tota o ka ikaegang ka one.
support_story_2_body: Go latedisa serweboleta sa semmuso sa Innioasis gantsi go raya go tlhotlhora diforamo go bona dikgokagano tsa Google Drive tse di feletsweng ke nako, dišere tsa kwa marung tsa Baidu tse di suleng, le difaele tsa zip tsa masaitsiweng tse di senang didirisiwa tse di phatsimang. Re agile neteweke e e ikanyegang, e e ikemetseng ya go laisolola e e nang le bothokgami jo bo netefaditsweng jwa SHA-256, dikitsiso tsa ntšhwafatso, le go tsenya go go kaelwang kgato ka kgato. Meneelo ya gago e boloka ka tlhamalalo di-download le go amogela tse di dirang gore seno se kgonege diura di le 24 ka letsatsi, malatsi a le 365 ka ngwaga.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Ditaisololo tse di bonako, tse di tlhamaletseng tse di senang melelwane ya go laisolola kgotsa dikgokagano tse di suleng.
support_story_2_item_2: Dikitsiso tsa Ntšhwafatsa: Lemosiwa ka nako ya fa ditokololo tse disha tsa baagi kgotsa ditokafatso di wela.
support_story_2_item_3: Ditlhomo tse di Kaelwang tsa Kgato ka Kgato: Ditlhotlheletso tsa pono tse di bonalang sentle di go tsamaisa mo tobetsong nngwe le nngwe ya konopo.
support_story_2_item_4: Setšhaba sa Dipuo tse dintsi: E rulagantswe ka botlalo ka Seesemane, Setšhaena, Sejeremane, Sepanishe, Sefora le Sejapane.
support_story_3_headline: Go lotlolola bokgoni jo bo feletseng jwa motshameki wa gago wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Go tlisa Rockbox, ditsamaiso tsa tiriso tse di botlhofo tse di itiretsweng, le kgololesego ya audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Software ya feketori ya setoko e tlhotlhora fela se se hardware ya gago ya Y1 kgotsa Y2 e ka se dirang. Baagi ba rona ba ne ba dira gore Rockbox, ditsamaiso tsa go dira tse di botlhofo tse di itiretsweng, go tshameka ga codec ya audiophile, le ditlhogo tse di itiretsweng di tshele. Re reka dipharologano tsa serweboleta sa mmatota go tswa mo kgetsaneng go leka, go boela morago, le go netefatsa go tsenngwa ga sengwe le sengwe. Tshegetsa Updater ka tlhamalalo go thusa diyuniti tseno tsa teko ka madi le go potlakisa tlhabololo ya firmware e e itiretsweng.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox ya Tobetso e le nngwe: Go tshameka ga Audiophile le ditlhogo tse di tlwaelegileng tse di tsenngwang mo metsotswaneng.
support_story_3_item_2: Serweboleta sa Baagi: Ditokafatso tsa beteri, UI e e phepa, le tshegetso ya segompieno ya codec ya modumo.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Re dira diteko mo didirisiweng tsa mmatota tsa mmele pele ga re golola kago epe.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% mahala, sephiri-pele Software e se nang dipapatso kapa ho latedisa.
support_story_4_headline: Re thuse go dira se Innioasis e sa se direng.
support_story_4_lead: Go boloka serweboleta se se tsamaisiwang ke baagi go boloka didiriswa tsa gago di se mo mafelong a go latlhela matlakala.
support_story_4_body: Fa khamphani ya didirisiwa tsa khomphiutha e fetela kwa sedirisiweng sa yone se se latelang, dikai tsa bogologolo di a tlogelwa. Innioasis ga e neele tshegetso ya Linux, ga e na di-changelog tse di bonaletsang, e bile ga e na tsela e e bonolo ya go boela mannong fa go tsenya go palelwa. Updater e teng ka gonne badirisi ba ba nang le phisego ga ba a tshwanela go latlha sebapadi sa mmino se se siameng ka botlalo. 100% ya meneelo ya baagi e tsena ka tlhamalalo mo go bolokeng sediriswa seno se buletswe mongwe le mongwe.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Go boela mo mannong go go supilweng go a elela le fa didiriswa di gana go simolola.
support_story_4_item_2: Tshegetso ya Setlhopha sa Ntlha sa Linux: MediaTek e e phatsima e e tshegediwang ka botlalo mo di-distros tsa Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Diphetogo tse di bonaletsang: Dintlha tsa kgololo tse di tseneletseng gore o itse sentle gore ke diphetogo dife.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% E tshegediwa ke Baagi: Kofi nngwe le nngwe e dira gore akhaefe e nne e bulegile e bile e sa duelelwe ke botlhe.

err_sp_da_invalid_type: Motshameki o ganne moemedi wa go laisolola (phoso 6104). Dirisa Moemedi wa Laisolola o o kopantsweng le Sediriswa sa SP Flash, mme o tlhole gore a serweboleta se tsamaisana le setshamekisi seno.

err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Lefelo la USB COM ga le a kgona go bulwa (phoso ya 1013). Go simolola khomphutha ya gago gape go tla golola port e e notletsweng. Tsweetswee simolola khomphutara ya gago gape o bo o leka gape.
err_sp_enable_dram: Sediriswa se ne se sa kgone go simolola memori wa motshameki. Dirisa sephuthelwana se se ageletsweng sekai seno se se tlhomameng.

err_attempt_timeout: Sediriswa se se phatsima ga se a ka sa bontsha kgatelopele epe mo metsotswaneng ya {seconds}, ka jalo maiteko ano a ne a emisiwa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Ga e a kgona go tlhoma kgolagano e e tlhomameng le motshameki. Netefatsa gore sediriswa se timilwe (dirisa pine go tobetsa konopo ya go seta gape fa go tlhokega), ntsha USB mo polakeng, mme o golaganye gape fa o kopiwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Go phatsima go ne ga kgaosediwa kgotsa tiro ya go kwala e ne ya palelwa. Tlhola gore thapo ya USB e tsentswe sentle mo polakeng le gore beteri e na le tšhatšhe e e lekaneng, o bo o leka gape.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Sediriswa se se phatsimang se bontshitse mola o o tshwanang mo metsotswaneng ya bofelo ya {seconds} mme ga go lebege se tswelela go kwala sediriswa sa khomphiutha. Folashe e ka tswa e paletswe. Fa e le gore seno e ne e le sa bofelo mo maitekong a mabedi ka mokgwa mongwe le mongwe mo tsamaisong e e ka boelang morago fa gare ga tsone, kgotsa fa e le gore ke MTKClient fela e e leng teng mo motšhineng ono, simolola khomphutara gape mme o leke gape.
err_only_mtkclient_title: Ke tlelaente ya MTK fela e e leng teng
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Ke MTKClient fela e e leng teng mo go tsenyeng gono. Folashe e ka tswa e paletswe. Tsweetswee simolola khomphutara gape o bo o leka gape.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Khomphutha ena e ka boela ya kenya ka ho sebedisa Sesebediswa sa SP Flash. Fa o ka kgona, fetogela kwa Sedirisweng sa SP Flash mme o leke gape.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Folashe e ka tswa e paletswe. Tsweetswee buisa molaetsa o o fa godimo mme o simolole khomphutha gape pele o leka gape. Fa o tobetsa OK, tiriswa e tla ema gore o kgone go simolola gape.
err_missing_package_files_title: Sephuthelwana sa Serweboleta se se sa direng
err_missing_package_files_desc: Sephuthelwana sa firmware se tlhaela faele ya go gasaganya kgotsa difaele tsa setshwantsho tse di tlhokegang. Tsweetswee laisolola gape sephuthelwana kgotsa tlhopha faele e e feletseng ya serweboleta.
err_auth_file_unusable_title: Faele ya Netefatso ga e dirisiwe
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Faele ya netefatso e o e tlhophileng ga e yo, ga e na sepe kgotsa ga e a kgona go kwalwa. Tlhopha faele e e dirang, kgotsa e phimole mo Diseting, o bo o phatsima gape.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Sediriswa se se Phatsimang ga se yo
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Sediriswa se se phatsimang kgotsa bakgweetsi ba tsamaiso ba ba tlhokegang ga ba kgone go simololwa. Tsweetswee tlhola ditetlelelo tsa tsamaiso, thulaganyo ya mokgweetsi, kgotsa tsenya tiriswa gape.
err_driver_missing_title: Mokgweetsi wa USB wa MediaTek o a tlhokega
err_driver_missing_desc: Phoso ena e ka etsahala ha mokganni wa MediaTek USB a sa kenngwa. Tobetsa Laisolola Dikgweetsi go tsenya mokgweetsi wa MediaTek USB, simolola khomphutha ya gago gape, o bo o leka gape.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Faele ya serweboleta se se bolokilweng ga e yo. Tlhopha Tlhopha Serweboleta go aga sešwa difaele tse di ntshitsweng kgotsa laisolola akhaefe ya serweboleta gape. Se ke bothata jwa faele ya selegae, e seng bothata jwa kgolagano ya USB.

sel_cache_retry_select_release: Tlhopha tokololo ya serweboleta se o tla se laisololang gape.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Go nnile le phoso e e sa lebelelwang ka nako ya go tsenya ({detail}). Tima setshamekisi gotlhelele, golagana gape fa o kopiwa, o bo o leka gape.

flash_failover_note: {method} ga e a simolola go tsenya. Fa setshamekisi se sena go timiwa le go ntshiwa mo polakeng, go tla dirisiwa {other} boemong jwa sone.
themepack_card_title: Tsenya Sephuthelwana sa Setlhogo sa Rockbox sa 360p
themepack_card_desc: E akaretsa ditlhogo tse dintle tsa baagi, ditshwantsho tsa lemorago tsa resolushene e e kwa godimo, le difonte tse di diretsweng dipontsho tsa 360p ka tlhamalalo.

themepack_step1_title: Kgato 1: Golagana mo Mokgweng wa Polokelo ya USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Tobetsa setshamekisi sa gago ka go tshwara konopo ya Power.
2. Fa Rockbox e simolola, tsenya thapo ya USB mo khomphuteng ya gago.
3. Fa o kopiwa mo sekirining sa setshamekisi, netefatsa mokgwa wa Polokelo ya USB gore sediriswa se tlhagelele jaaka kgweetso.
themepack_step2_title: Kgato 2: Tlhopha Setsholadifaele sepe mo Setshamekisi
themepack_step2_desc: Ka gonne ditsamaiso tsa tiriso (tse di jaaka macOS) di fitlha difaele tsa marontho (tse di jaaka .rockbox) ka thulaganyetsoruri, o ka tlhopha foltara EPE kgotsa modi wa polatefomo mo setshamekisi sa gago. Re tla go batlela kgotsa re go direla lenaanethalo la .rockbox ka go itirisa.
themepack_status_downloading: Go laisolola Sephuthelwana sa Setlhogo sa 360p...
themepack_complete: Theme pack e tsentswe ka katlego! Jaanong o ka kgaola setshamekisi sa gago ka pabalesego mme wa tlhopha setlhogo mo Rockbox (Diseting > Diseting tsa Setlhogo).
themepack_err_not_found: Ga e kgone go bona kgotsa go simolola lenaanethalo la .rockbox mo polatefomong e e tlhophilweng. Tsweetswee tlhomamisa gore o tlhophile foltara mo setshamekising sa gago.

rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Kgaola thapo ya USB.
2. Tsenya motshameko motlakase gape mme o o tlogele o boot mo Rockbox.
3. Fa Rockbox e setse e dira, golaganya gape thapo ya USB, o bo o tobetsa Tswelela.

rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App e lebile kgolagano ya ADB (go fitlha go metsotswana e le 30). Haeba sesebediswa se fumanwe, dihlooho di fetiswa mme sebapadi se qala botjha ka ho iketsahalla. Ho seng jwalo, tlolela pele ho Mokgwa wa Polokelo ya USB.

rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Tsenya ka Mokgwa wa Polokelo wa USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Kgontsha Mokgwa wa Polokelo wa USB mo setshamekisi gore e tlhagelele jaaka kgweetso.
2. Tlhopha foltara EPE mo setshamekisi se se fa tlase (.rockbox, Mmino, Ditlhogo, kgotsa modi wa polatefomo, foltara e e fitlhegileng ya .rockbox e bonwa ka go itirisa).
3. App e kopanya dihlooho tsa 360p le difonte ka, ho ngola difaele tsa lebitso le le leng.
